params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: { id?, fields, sidebar?, heading?, saveLabel?, editable?, label?, emptyHeading? }.

params.name: Load
params.doc: Loads the record whose id (config.id, the route's param) is given, as its values keyed by field name; null shows the 'record not found' state. Not called for a new record (no id). Throwing shows the element's error state.

params.name: Save
params.doc: Saves the form's values, keyed by field name (read text with GetString(), a number with GetDecimal()). Having it shows Edit and Save. Throwing keeps the edits and shows the exception message; returning switches to view mode.

notes: New component: App framework step 7 (issue #353). Load(id) and Save(values) are callback properties (business logic), set from script, so the generated component hands the element a .NET reference (PkCallbackSlot) that calls the Load and Save parameters, as PkSettingsPage does for Save (issue #1000). Blazor already has the same page concept as PkRecordForm (a PkForm with a toolbar, error alert and a PkDetailLayout sidebar, with the state kept by the page or PkRecordEditor, and ActionsInHeader for the sticky title bar); PkRecordPage is the config-driven element, PkRecordForm stays the composable Razor template.
